pages.text: Just as you can craft armor for your Wolves and Wargs, you can also forge protective gear for Black Beasts using the same metals at your disposal. Naturally, due to their larger size, crafting such armor requires more materials.

You can remove the armor from your Black Beast using Shears. If the armor is damaged, you can repair it on an Anvil with the metal ingot (either material can be used for repairs), or simply right-click the armored Black Beast while holding a Cursed Metal Ingot or Dark Metal Ingot—though this will restore less durability.
